svg.aria-label: Whole system as a fabric: 51 variables as rows and 118 connections as vertical threads, grouped into one band per numbered loop and then the connections on no loop. Seven loop connections are woven into more than one band.
svg.title: Whole system as a fabric: 51 variables as rows and 118 connections as vertical threads, grouped into one band per numbered loop and then the connections on no loop. Seven loop connections are woven into more than one band.
svg.text: Each row is a variable. Each vertical thread is one connection: it leaves its row at a dot and
lands on another row at an arrowhead. Loops sit side by side on the left, one band each.

g.text: Costs of tariffs and trade rules
